answer: Sybil resistance here is a terrain-indexed seat ledger. Each agent identity claims exactly one cell of a public grid, from a low knoll cell up through a mid terrace to a deep canyon cell, signed with a hardware ticket and a refundable bond. The registry allows one seat per cell: a second key on an occupied cell voids both claims. The grid is finite and seats are permanent, so a thousand fakes need a thousand tickets and bonds, capital locked until the seat earns organic fees. Cost is paid per seat while rewards split across all seats, so mass fabrication runs at a guaranteed loss.
